name: Curtin Singapore
summary: Singapore campus of Curtin University (Australia) with two-year Commerce, Computing and Information Technology degrees on three-trimester years.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 24 points from 6 subjects at one sitting, 3 at Higher Level and one of them English. Lower scores point to Curtin’s diploma route; English tests apply if not English-medium.

noDeadline: Rolling; offer documents due 6 weeks before the course starts

programmes.name: Commerce
programmes.about: A flexible business degree where you study one major (accounting, finance, international business, logistics and supply chain, management or marketing) or a double major; the school holds AACSB accreditation.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma of at least 24 points from 6 subjects at one sitting, 3 at Higher Level, one of them English. English also needs IELTS 6.0 unless your schooling was in English.

needs.note: One of your six IB subjects must be English

programmes.selectionNote: Admitted if you meet the minimum IB score and English requirement; no ranking or interview is published. Intakes: February, July, November.

programmes.name: Computing (Cyber Security)
programmes.about: Computing degree that starts from programming in C and Java and Linux skills, then specialises in cyber security: cryptography, access policy, computer forensics and intrusion detection.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma of at least 24 points from 6 subjects at one sitting, 3 at Higher Level, one of them English. English also needs IELTS 6.0 unless your schooling was in English.

needs.note: One of your six IB subjects must be English
Mathematics is an essential prerequisite; calculus is desirable

programmes.selectionNote: Admitted if you meet the minimum IB score and English requirement; no ranking or interview is published. Intakes: February, July.

programmes.name: Information Technology
programmes.about: Covers programming (in Python), computer networks and security, specialising in distributed computing, with Linux skills taught from the basics upward.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma of at least 24 points from 6 subjects at one sitting, 3 at Higher Level, one of them English. English also needs IELTS 6.0 unless your schooling was in English.

needs.note: One of your six IB subjects must be English
Mathematics is an essential prerequisite; calculus is desirable

programmes.selectionNote: Admitted if you meet the minimum IB score and English requirement; no ranking or interview is published. Intakes: February, July.

notes: Each degree takes 2 years full-time (6 trimesters); the Commerce page lists six single majors and six double majors, all one degree.
The Communications and Nursing conversion courses are top-ups for diploma holders and registered nurses, so they are not listed.
International applicants need a Student’s Pass; the tuition fee shown includes 9% GST and is indicative, with annual increases.
